queries.query: SELECT h.ts_id, h.ts_key, CASE h.time_dim WHEN 1 THEN '15 Minuten' WHEN 2 THEN '1 Stunde' WHEN 3 THEN 'Tag' WHEN 4 THEN 'Monat' WHEN 5 THEN 'Jahr' END AS dimension, u.symbol, c.iso_code, o.object_key, h.description, h.created_at, h.updated_at FROM ts_header h JOIN ts_unit u ON u.unit_id = h.unit_id LEFT JOIN ts_currency c ON c.currency_id = h.currency_id LEFT JOIN ts_object o ON o.object_id = h.object_id ORDER BY h.ts_key
